delta.comment: Contract replanning (operator-directed, 2026-08-19): clause-to-carrier matrix corrected to be EXHAUSTIVE. C2 was missing github-pr-automation; C3 was missing both fix-ci and _ship.agent.md.tmpl despite 134.004-T authoring both C3 dispositions there. Consequence: the matrix as written would not have detected ANY of the three prior fix-cycle defects, because each lived on a surface not listed as a carrier of the clause it broke. Added a carrier-completeness guard tying the matrix to the tasks that author each clause. Scope split: this task keeps structural coverage (byte identity, checksums, presence matrix); the semantic regression suite moved to new sibling 134.012-T to stay within the 2-hour rule.

Readiness fix cycle 1 (P1.1, review of 1dad725a): carrier matrix corrected a second time and designated the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. C2 had omitted both authoritative workflow-policies.md.tmpl and circuit-breaker.instructions.md.tmpl (134.005-T criterion 6 states the C2 capture-before-close requirement); C3 had omitted circuit-breaker.instructions.md.tmpl (criterion 7 carries the H12 symmetric guard). Registry was listed inconsistently despite authoring all seven clauses - fixed with an explicit registry rule. Root cause: matrix was derived by reading carriers ad hoc rather than inverting the authoring set, and existed in three independently maintained copies (here, H11, 134.012-T). H11 and 134.012-T now reference this block instead of restating it. Verified by a complete inversion sweep over all 12 tasks for C2/C3/C5.

Readiness fix cycle 2 (review of b449dcbf, P1.1/P1.2): full C1-C7 re-inversion. C1 gained the four procedural loop-gate carriers (004, 006, 007 x2); C4 gained github-pr-automation and pr-lifecycle Stop-Conditions carriers; C5 gained the four Stage-only-reprioritization procedural carriers plus 008's Stage-side authority statement. Added CARRIER ROLES ([A]/[N]/[P]/[G]) and the CLAUSE -> BEHAVIOR -> CARRIER-SUBSET mapping B1-B15, because an expanded row asserted with one identical marker would be unsatisfiable for carriers H5 forbids from restating registry prose and for surfaces with no review thread. Carrier-completeness guard rewritten to span all seven rows and invert a declared AUTHORING_TASKS constant for tasks 001-009; the prior guard checked C2/C3 only and omitted 134.005-T from its own expected set, so it could not have caught the omission it was written for. Recorded as MATRIX CORRECTION 3 with the CARRIER-ROLE RATIONALE.

Readiness fix cycle 3 (review of 904c46b9, P1): fix-ci corrected from threadless-only to DUAL-PATH, verified read-only against templates/skills/fix-ci/SKILL.md.tmpl (description "Detect CI pipeline failures and review comments"; Step 2.5 thread inventory, Step 3 categorization, Step 6 reply + GraphQL resolveReviewThread, Step 6.5 NON-NEGOTIABLE reply gate). C3 row and B7 now include fix-ci; B8 scoped to its CI-finding path. Added the DUAL-PATH SURFACES rule: a carrier's path set is determined by the finding kinds it actually handles, verified against the template, never inferred from the loop name. New root cause distinct from corrections 1-3: inverting the authoring set detects under-listed carriers but inherits factual errors already in the criteria - 134.007-T's true statement about a CI FINDING was generalized into a false claim about the fix-ci SURFACE. Also removed a verbatim duplicate of the MATRIX CORRECTION paragraph introduced by my own cycle-2 edit.

Stage correction operation (checkpoint-20260819-165602, 2026-08-19): registered B16 `c3-dual-path-selection` and B17 `c2-existing-entry-reuse` in the single authoritative CLAUSE -> BEHAVIOR -> CARRIER-SUBSET MAPPING, closing the gap where fix cycle 3's two new semantic assertions were substantively correct but unnumbered and therefore outside the audit. Both are DERIVED rather than hand-listed: B16 = B7 INTERSECT B8 = {001[A], 004, 007-fix-ci}; B17 = B6 UNION {007-fix-ci} = {004, 007-fix-ci, 008}, inheriting B6's declared exemption from the clause-row subset check because both descend from the single-write invariant (a Ship ROLE property, not a registry clause), which is why 008 appears while absent from the C2 row. Authoritative range is now B1-B17 and declared complete. MATRIX CORRECTION 5 records the root cause: prior guards policed only entries already IN the map and nothing asserted the map was complete with respect to the suite -- an unnumbered assertion is a missing entry, not a wrong one, and is structurally invisible to a guard that validates existing entries. Same shape as CORRECTION 3 one level up. B17's fix-ci membership verified read-only against fix-ci/SKILL.md.tmpl Step 6.5 (re-queries for threads opened since Step 2.5), the only mechanism by which a thread can surface after the capture write within a single run.

Same operation: added the CROSS-FILE BEHAVIOUR ALLOCATION block to the authoritative mapping, declaring that the seventeen behaviours split across the feature's TWO contract-test files -- 134.012-T owns B1, B3-B12, B14, B16, B17; this task owns B2 (literal-clause test), B13 (precedence test) and B15 (policy-registry test). The two sets must be disjoint and their union must equal B1-B17 exactly, enforced by the RANGE-COMPLETENESS guard in 134.012-T. The three criteria in this task now carry their behaviour IDs so the allocation is machine-checkable from both sides rather than inferred. This closes the gap where a behaviour could be claimed by both files (duplication of the kind that caused the original matrix drift) or by neither (the invisible-assertion failure MATRIX CORRECTION 5 exists to prevent).

B16/B17 correction review cycle 1 (HEAD 77d1a7e0, P1.1+P1.2 -- both defects introduced by the preceding correction-5 pass). P1.1: B16 was defined as selecting between the two C3 dispositions by FINDING KIND, contradicting the authoritative selector. 001 states C3 as WHERE A REVIEW THREAD EXISTS / WHERE NO REVIEW THREAD EXISTS and 004 states its threadless path as 'no review thread exists for the finding at the moment it is classified' -- both select on ACTUAL THREAD AVAILABILITY. Disproof: a pre-PR local-review finding is review-kind yet threadless (Ship's local review runs before PR creation), so a kind-based selector would demand a reply on a nonexistent thread. Root cause: correction 4's finding-kind rule governs PRESENCE (which dispositions a surface carries); correction 5 lifted it into SELECTION. fix-ci's path split is a surface-local IMPLEMENTATION of thread availability, not a competing rule. Fixed: behaviour renamed c3-dual-disposition-carriage with shared behaviour = dual CARRIAGE and explicitly carrier-specific selectors (001/004 thread availability; 007-fix-ci path split); presence-vs-selection distinction stated in DUAL-PATH SURFACES; 134.007-T's dual-path sentence scoped so it cannot seed the generalization again. P1.2: CROSS-FILE BEHAVIOUR ALLOCATION counted B2/B13/B15 as discharged on attribution rather than coverage -- B2 asserted on 005 alone with 3 of 4 phrases and no worked cases (subset is {001,005}), B13 on 008 alone (subset is {001,008}), B15 by section-presence that would pass against telemetry-without-halt. Root cause: SUBSET-FIDELITY checked OWNED behaviours against declared subsets but nothing checked DISCHARGED_ELSEWHERE ones; a partially-covered behaviour reported green is worse than an uncovered one. Fixed: discharge is now a coverage claim cross-checked against declared subset and mapped clause text, all three tests expanded to full subsets, allocation and coverage recorded as separate properties. MATRIX CORRECTION 6 records both.

Correction cycle 2 (HEAD 663205a6, P1.1/P1.2/P2). P1.1: authoritative C1 declares FIVE insufficient discriminators ('same file','same function','same PR','same subsystem','related'); 134.005-T's operational restatement carried four and the B2 assertion demanded four. Root cause: correction 6 raised B2 from three to four by counting phrases in the RESTATEMENT (005) rather than in the AUTHORITATIVE clause (001) -- the restating carrier is by definition the surface that can drift, so it can never be the source of truth for its own completeness. B2 now resolves the count from 001 explicitly and states that requirement in the criterion; 'related' added to 134.005-T. P1.2: the C3 symmetric guard is a TWO-PART clause -- (i) same-contract-surface completion IS in scope and must be fixed, not deferred; AND (ii) deferring one without a captured entry AND a residual-risk record is itself a P-021 violation actioned per C7. 134.004-T and 134.007-T carried only part (i); 134.005-T carried part (ii) without the residual-risk record. The B9 test already required the complete form, so the semantic suite was UNSATISFIABLE against its own carrier contracts -- a contradiction that would have surfaced only at implementation time. Both parts now stated in all four mapped carriers (001/004/005/007-fix-ci); B9 subset deliberately UNCHANGED since the correction concerns what each mapped carrier states, not which carriers state it, and creates no obligation on 006 or pr-lifecycle. MATRIX CORRECTION 7 records both. These are the inverse of every earlier finding: test correct, carrier contract wrong.

Authority audit (correction cycle 3 of 3, operator-directed). Every acceptance criterion in this task and 134.012-T was resolved against its owning artifact. Fixed here: the H1 role-boundary guard omitted ARCHIVAL, which owner 134.002-T declares as "discretionary removal/archival" -- the guard would have passed against a Role Boundary permitting Ship to discretionarily archive a Stage-owned deferred entry. Added the AUTHORITY-OWNER MAP naming the owning artifact for every class of claim the two contract-test files assert, so Ship implements without re-deriving it. Recorded MATRIX CORRECTION 8, including the claims verified CORRECT (byte-identity list correctly excludes non-dogfooded S1/S7; Amendment Log 1.20.0; six-field payload and B4 exclusion of 005; post-merge Step 7 vs Step 6 creation; 134.010-T outside AUTHORING_TASKS; B3/B7/B11/B12 subsets) so no later cycle re-derives them.

Owner-contract reconciliation (checkpoint-20260819-183625), MATRIX CORRECTION 9. Behaviour range extended B1-B17 -> B1-B18. New B18 c5-reference-role-recognition -> 003[N] ONLY, split out of B11: hardening H5 contracts 134.003-T to REFERENCE C5 by policy ID and clause label rather than restate it, so B11's old subset demanded the creation grant and the manifest-derived cleanup exception on a surface contracted NOT to carry them. B11 now resolves to 001[A], 002[N] and keeps the complete boundary semantics on their real owners. B11's verb set now names discretionary removal AND archival per owner 134.002-T. B17 reuse re-scoped from "this run" to the expansion's stable deferred-entry ID across CURRENT OR PRIOR runs, because a CI finding captured with review-thread ID N/A commonly gains a thread only in a later run. Allocation, cross-file union, and hardening H11 updated to B1-B18. Audit: 18 IDs defined, no gaps, no duplicates; all 15 owned behaviours asserted in 134.012-T; no foreign IDs.

Owner-reconciliation review cycle 2 (HEAD 53b080fa, P1x2). P1.2 resolved here: added carrier role [R] REFERENCE-ONLY and re-inverted role-enforcement from [N] to [R] on the C5 row and in B18. The [N] NORMATIVE RESTATEMENT legend explicitly designated role-enforcement for C5, so even after the B11/B18 split removed the false boundary-semantics requirement, the role marker still resolved to restated clause prose that H5 and 134.003-T L34 contract that surface NOT to carry -- reintroducing the same false requirement through the legend. [R] is asserted on its policy-ID/clause-label citation plus its recognition/fail-closed enforcement behaviour, never on clause prose, with an explicit rule that any marker satisfiable only by restated policy text is a defect against the role. Updated: [N] legend (no longer claims role-enforcement), C5 matrix row, B18 subset and rationale, the role-marker rule in the clause-coverage criterion, the AUTHORITY-OWNER MAP role list, hardening H11 narrative, and the plan's role narrative. Recorded MATRIX CORRECTION 10. Audit after changes: 18 IDs, no gaps/dupes, allocation disjoint, union exactly B1-B18, all 15 owned behaviours asserted, none foreign, zero residual 003[N].

PR #372 Copilot review-fix cycle 1 — MATRIX CORRECTION 11 recorded. This task's AUTHORITY-OWNER MAP was updated for the C4 owner clause (active-cycle boundary, forward-acting authorization), 134.004-T's new sole ownership of the deferred-entry discovery procedure and its asymmetric fail-safe, and 134.008-T's archive-not-remove verb. The CROSS-FILE BEHAVIOUR ALLOCATION is now THREE-WAY after 012 was split (thread PRRT_kwDORzpWpM6amwKd): 011 owns B2/B13/B15, 012 owns B3/B4/B5/B6/B7/B8/B9/B16/B17, 013 owns B1/B10/B11/B12/B14/B18 — pairwise disjoint, union = B1-B18. Two lineage invariants are now written down because they constrain any future split: derived behaviours must sit with their parents (B16 = B7 intersect B8, B17 = B6 union {007-fix-ci}), and split behaviours stay with their siblings (B18 came out of B11). All "two contract-test files" references updated to three. Correction 11's root-cause note is the new one: every prior cycle tested the artifacts against EACH OTHER, and three of these five findings are rules that were mutually consistent yet could not be EXECUTED — internal consistency is not executability.

PR #372 review-fix cycle 2 — MATRIX CORRECTION 12 recorded, and the CROSS-FILE BEHAVIOUR ALLOCATION block gained a new rule: OWNER INVENTORIES ARE DERIVED, NEVER DECLARED. Each split file's list of authoring tasks is the UNION of the authoring tasks in the carrier subsets of that file's OWNED_BEHAVIOURS, computed from the mapping -- a convenience listing for the implementer, not a second source of truth. Where an inventory and the mapping disagree, THE MAPPING WINS and the inventory is the defect. The three current unions are recorded so they can be checked without recomputation: 011 -> {001, 005, 008}; 012 -> {001, 004, 005, 006, 007, 008}; 013 -> {001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 006, 007, 008, 009}; they MUST be recomputed whenever a behaviour moves between files. This task's own AUTHORING_TASKS carrier-completeness guard was checked and is NOT affected: it legitimately spans every content task 001-009 because it inverts the whole C1-C7 matrix rather than a per-behaviour subset, and it carries no marker-provenance inventory of the drifting kind.

PR #372 review-fix cycle 3. AUTHORITY-OWNER MAP entries for 004 (four-case truth table; both discovery-failure paths capture; reuse requires positive confirmation) and 008 (two independent triggers; neither read off the other) rewritten. MATRIX CORRECTION 11 marked SUPERSEDED IN PART with a forward pointer, not rewritten -- it remains the dated record of cycle 1's defective two-direction fail-safe. MATRIX CORRECTION 12 corrected for P2-1: 002 was never a B12 carrier (B12 subset = 001[A], 004, 006, 007-pr-lifecycle, 007-fix-ci), so 012's listing of 002 was never map-supported, a different defect class from 013's genuine post-split staleness. MATRIX CORRECTION 13 appended, recording both P1s, the P2s, the 007 restatement, and the durable rule: A SAFETY MECHANISM MAY NOT ASSERT THE GUARANTEE IT DEPENDS ON -- neither the AUTHORITY-OWNER MAP audit nor the owner-obligation audits catch a bare assertion ABOUT another artifact, since both only verify that a claim matches its owner.

Fresh Stage correction operation (post-budget-exhaustion, 2026-08-19). MATRIX CORRECTION 14 appended, recording the fourth-shape defect that evaded three accumulated negative guards, the mapped-carrier-with-no-authored-behaviour gap on 007-fix-ci, the B17 carrier-role scoping, and the two deliberate non-changes (006 and 007-pr-lifecycle remain unqualified because B5 excludes them). Live hardening range reference updated H1-H13 -> H1-H15. New hardening item H15 recorded: NEGATIVE GUARDS MUST ENUMERATE DEFECT SHAPES, NOT DEFECT INSTANCES -- for a rule over two independently-available fields the shapes are fused-into-one-token, both-qualified-together, one-qualified-and-not-the-other, neither-qualified-where-required, and rule-absent-entirely, the last being the most dangerous because it trips nothing.

Fresh Stage operation, review-fix cycle 1 of 3 (HEAD 071d3406). Recorded MATRIX CORRECTION 15: both P1s were regressions introduced by MATRIX CORRECTION 14 itself -- the first correction whose entire subject is damage done by the preceding correction. (1) A tail-splice from a truncated old_str merged the B6 SINGLE-WRITE criterion into a B5 criterion, so B6 stopped existing as an independent criterion while the allocation still claimed it; allocation tests missed it because they count MAPPINGS, not CRITERIA. (2) Fixing 134.007-T's missing B5 authorship by widening the shared payload criterion imposed B5 on excluded carriers 006 and 007-pr-lifecycle. Durable shape: FIXING AN ABSENCE BY WIDENING SCOPE IS ITSELF THE FALSE-REQUIREMENT FAILURE MODE, the exact mirror of the defect being fixed; where one file serves several surfaces, the rule belongs on the SURFACE, never the shared clause. Correction 9 established carrier ROLES are not uniform semantics; correction 15 establishes carrier SURFACES within one file are not uniform either. B5 subset assertion at L83 verified complete: 001[A], 004, 007-fix-ci, with NOT 006 / NOT 007-pr-lifecycle and rationale stated.

Fresh Stage operation, review-fix cycle 2 of 3 (HEAD be2ed019, P0=0/P1=1). P1 fixed here: this task's future test module was IMPORTED FROM but never required to EXPORT. 134.012-T's RANGE-COMPLETENESS guard imports an `OWNED_BEHAVIOURS` constant from BOTH sibling suites and 134.013-T already carried a matching ALLOCATION CONSTANT criterion, but this file carried none -- so two of the three constants were owned and the third existed only as an assertion inside the consumer. The consumer criterion was therefore not executable as written, and the only way to satisfy it would have been to hardcode this file's set in 012, recreating the duplicated-source-of-truth failure the matrix consolidation repaired and which H14 forbids. Added the producer-side ALLOCATION CONSTANT criterion: `OWNED_BEHAVIOURS == {B2, B13, B15}` (POLICY-CONTRACT group), every exercised behaviour a member and every member exercised, DECLARED here and IMPORTED there, with an explicit prohibition on restating the sibling sets or the union so no duplicate source of truth is introduced. This is a textbook H14 instance -- artifact X's correctness depending on a guarantee artifact Y was never obligated to provide -- and is now recorded as H14's second confirmed instance with the generalisation that AN IMPORT IS A DEPENDENCY ON A GUARANTEE.
